title: Chapter 1432
text:
Unexplored universe, capital of the Star Alliance.

Savignes quickly walked into the office of the Star Alliance Leader.

The Star Alliance Leader was waiting for his arrival. Seeing him enter the room, he put down the report in his hand, raised his head, and slowly said,

"How's the situation?"

"I've already given the order. The lurkers will take action soon," Savignes said with a deep voice.

"Hmm, this chess piece has been set up for so many years. Now is the time for them to play their role." The Star Alliance Leader paused for a moment before changing the topic. "However, you must pay attention to the way you provide information. Everything is based on the premise that you hide your existence. The three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree are both huge threats. If our existence is exposed to them, the dark clouds of war will also envelop us. With our strength, no matter which one it is, we will not be able to fight them head-on."

"Don't worry, we are now in a relationship where we are bound together for good or ill. We will not joke about the safety of the Star Alliance," Savignes said solemnly.

"Hmm, you have joined the Star Alliance for many years. We are already one. This operation is not only for us to eliminate potential threats, but also for you to take revenge." The Star Alliance Leader nodded.

"Yes, back then, we were defeated by the three Universal Civilizations, and only a few of our people managed to escape. It was almost impossible for us to continue, and we became a wandering civilization in the universe. If not for the Star Alliance's team, perhaps our civilization would have long perished. Even now, we are still grateful for the Star Alliance's help over the years."

Savignes lowered his head and spoke respectfully.

When the Lore Civilization was defeated, his ancestors had gathered the remaining members of his race and gathered them together, surviving with difficulty. Now, Savignes had taken over the authority of his predecessors and was the current leader of the Lore Civilization.

The history of the Lore Civilization was quite ancient. They were once a member of the explored universe and one of the competitors in the exploration era war. Unfortunately, they lost in the war, their civilization was shattered, and their home fell. Only a few survivors escaped in spaceships. Because they were worried that they would be eliminated, they resolutely entered the unexplored universe and left their homeland, becoming a group of universe wanderers.

After many trips through the wormhole, this group of wanderers happened to arrive at the territory of the Star Alliance.

The Star Alliance was a large-scale joint civilization formed by forty-six civilizations. They occupied a corner of the unexplored universe and silently reproduced. They had picked up this group of wanderers by chance, and the information that Lorre Wenming had brought with him immediately attracted their attention.

This was the first time the Star Alliance had learned of the existence of a powerful civilization in the outer space. The information provided by the Lore Civilization showed that the strength of the three Universal Civilizations was enough to destroy the entire Star Alliance. This caused the Star Alliance to be extremely wary and vigilant. In their eyes, the three Universal Civilizations could bring disaster to the Star Alliance at any time. Swallowing them was a huge hidden danger that made them unable to eat or sleep in peace.

In the face of an unfamiliar and powerful civilization, the Star Alliance did not dare to expose their existence and communicate with the other party. They could only observe silently. Under normal circumstances, even if the Star Alliance knew that a strong enemy was nearby, they would be helpless. However, the Lore Civilization had provided a way.

When the wanderers escaped from their hometowns, they brought a large number of coordinates with them. This was a priceless treasure, and the Star Alliance saw an opportunity.

Based on this information, the upper echelons of the Star Alliance finally decided on a strategic operation called the 'Observer Plan'. They sent out spies to the explored universe through wormholes, concealed their identities, collected information, and waited for an opportunity to monitor the three Universal Civilizations' every move.

The three Universal Civilizations did not have an Information Form warning network like the World Tree. Due to their huge territory, there would always be loopholes in the screening and warning mechanisms. As long as the outsiders operated properly, they would be able to successfully hide. In Han Xiao's previous life, the World Tree had hidden for many years and collected enough information. Then, it launched a surprise attack across the entire territory, causing the three Universal Civilizations to bleed.

The Star Alliance knew their own limits and did not think that their small body could withstand the three Universal Civilizations' trampling. Therefore, they only had the spies be responsible for observation and not participating in any other operations. They were like the lowest level of interstellar hackers, completely inconspicuous. They only searched for public information on the internet and did not seek any secrets. They were very cautious, which was why they were able to hide until today and secretly witness the development of the three Universal Civilizations.

After the Lore Civilization was repeatedly inspected by the Star Alliance, they finally became a new member of the Star Alliance and were able to reproduce. They had never forgotten their history and had always wanted revenge. They cooperated with the 'Observer Plan' and helped the Star Alliance hide in the explored universe. They were the real guides.

This time, the invasion of the three Universal Civilizations by the World Tree gave the Star Alliance hope of eliminating the threat. They could not beat the three Universal Civilizations themselves, so they could add fuel to the fire.

The leader of the Star Alliance rubbed the back of his hand and said, "We'll use the World Tree to get rid of the three Universal Civilizations, but the World Tree itself is also a new threat. The most ideal situation is for both sides to be injured, and we'll take advantage of it."

Savignes nodded heavily. "The three Universal Civilizations' technology level is very high. If we can annex their civilization achievements, we will be on the fast track of development."

"However, the risk is very high. We might expose ourselves, so we need to consider it carefully … If there's really a chance, we can't miss it."

The leader of the Star Alliance's eyes flickered. He naturally coveted the technological achievements of the three Universal Civilizations. Although the risks were high, the benefits were equally tempting.

The three Universal Civilizations had stabilized the situation and blocked the World Tree. This was not what the Star Alliance wanted to see. Destroying the good situation of the three Universal Civilizations and leading the flames of war into the entire galactic society was in line with their interests as a third party.

The leader of the Star Alliance did not mind taking advantage of the situation. Under the premise of hiding his origin, he secretly participated in this feast.

…

In the secondary dimension world.

An expedition team of the three Universal Civilizations was traveling in the secondary dimension, recording the coordinates of the dimension.

"This place is not far from the World Tree's stronghold dimension. There might be Blessed Race members appearing at any time. Brace yourselves and prepare to leave at any time."

In the bridge, the commander stared at the radar seriously and said with a serious tone.

Over the years, as the expeditionary army explored deeper and deeper, the chances of encountering the Blessed Race members of the World Tree became more frequent. Fortunately, they ran fast enough, and most of the time, they were not in danger.

However, it was not a good idea to always avoid danger. The search network of the Blessed Race members was very dense, and the expeditionary army did not want to have any conflicts. Therefore, the progress of the exploration was getting slower and slower, and there were not many loopholes to take advantage of.

"If this continues, I don't know when there will be a result. The World Tree has already arrived, and we don't have much time left …"

The commander sighed.

"Wu wu wu wu …"

Suddenly, an ear-piercing alarm sounded on the radar like a thunderclap, scaring everyone.

A beehive-shaped crack suddenly opened on the dimensional barrier not far away, and green streams of light shuttled over.

"It's the Blessed Race of the World Tree! Retreat! "

The commander's expression changed, and he instantly gave the order.

The expedition team immediately turned around and locked onto the preset route of retreat. The shuttle engine buzzed, and they turned into a stream of light, instantly leaving this dimension and escaping to another secondary dimension.

However, before the expedition team could stop, the alarm on the radar sounded again. The spatial crack opened again, and another group of Blessed Race members of the World Tree rushed over.

"This is a premeditated attack!"

The commander immediately reacted. With a heavy expression, he ordered the fleet to continue fleeing.

The fleet shuttled through five secondary dimensions in a row, and the Blessed Race members of the World Tree followed closely behind them like they were herding sheep.

Suddenly, the commander stopped running. He took a deep breath, made up his mind, and said in a deep voice, "Don't worry.

"Prepare to self-destruct."

Hearing this, the hearts of the crew members in the bridge trembled. They did not say anything or object, only silently activating the self-destruction program.

The soldiers of the three Universal Civilizations were not like the World Tree who could revive at will. Without the protection of the Underworld, they would truly die in battle. All the expedition teams were mentally prepared before they set off. If the situation was not right, they would sacrifice the entire fleet and self-destruct.

The stabilizer of the energy core disintegrated, and the psionic energy that had lost control showed signs of expanding, emitting a strong light.

"It's an honor to work with all of you. May the dynasty last forever."

The commander glanced at the resolute crew members and saluted. He then looked out of the porthole at the World Tree pursuers who had just arrived. He closed his eyes and prepared to welcome his death.

Buzz!

However, at this moment, everything froze. All the crew members could not move, and the progress of the self-destruction program stopped. The psionic energy that was about to go out of control stopped for an instant.

The figure of the Secret Tree King appeared in the cabin unknowingly. Looking at everyone's determined expressions, he sneered and clicked his tongue.

"You're quite unyielding. It's a pity that I'm here personally. No matter how determined you are, it's useless."

The Secret Tree King maintained the effect of the Spacetime Stop spell. With a light rub of his palm, the green power of the Tree King spread out and turned into a spatial crack. A python-like root of the World Tree extended out from it and penetrated all the battleships of the expedition team. It also split out more tiny tree roots and stabbed into the bodies of all the crew members.

Then, these roots were like straws, constantly absorbing the essence. At the same time, they modified this team at the Information Form level, turning them into one of their own. The expedition team slowly merged into the World Tree's roots as if they had sunk into the deep sea.

This process lasted for a long time before the World Tree sucked the entire expedition team in. Then, with a flash of light, it spat them out again. However, it was different from before. All the crew members had green light flowing on their bodies, and they were modified into members of the World Tree.

"Your Excellency Tree King."

These soldiers from the Red Empire all lowered their heads and bowed respectfully.

The Secret Tree King ignored them and sank into the mental network, sharing the memories of these people and the voyage log of the spaceship.

After browsing for a while, the Secret Tree King's eyes flashed, and a playful expression appeared on his face.

"Heh, so you were hiding here. I've found your nest."

At this moment, the Secret Tree King's mind suddenly moved. He sensed some special changes and looked into the distance.

"Foreseeing me? You don't know the meaning of death. "

A cold look appeared in the Secret Tree King's eyes. His hand gesture changed, and his magic power surged out, following the mysterious feeling to attack the source.

At the same time, somewhere on Floating Dragon Island.

"Pfft!"

Aesop was feeling the sudden passive foresight when his mind suddenly trembled. His brain seemed to have been hit by a hammer, and he fell to the ground with a shocked expression.

A wave of biting cold magic power shattered the foresight in his mind, and at the same time, it also severely damaged his spirit.

Those who could cause a Foreseer to suffer a backlash were basically all Mages. Different Foreseers had different Foreseers, and the difficulty of the backlash would also change. However, Aesop's Foreseer ability was not ordinary. Over the years, he had experienced countless passive Foreseers, and he had also Foreseen many Beyond Grade A Mages. The worst-case scenario was that his Foreseer failed. This was the first time someone had caused him a backlash.
